configuration_profile: direct configuration tokenizer plus ngx_conf_param with an accept-all directive handler
allocator_mode: NGX_DEBUG_PALLOC=1 with a fresh nginx pool per input
justification: The broad HTTP target parses one fixed embedded configuration only during setup, so mutated configuration syntax never reaches ngx_conf_read_token.
state: Each input gets a fresh pool, argument array, buffer and configuration context; the tokenizer is driven to a terminal result with a progress bound, then the public command-line parameter parser replays the same bytes.
known_limitations: The accept-all handler tests lexical and parser control flow, not semantic validation by individual module directives.
ngx_conf_param intentionally rejects block directives; the direct tokenizer pass still exercises braces and block token return codes.
File refill, include/glob processing and the 4096-byte file-token limit are not modeled because the input is an in-memory command-line-style buffer.
The one-function exposure patch is applied only to the isolated instrumented build copy.

scopes.contract: Splits configuration text into bounded arguments while handling comments, quotes, escapes, variables, statement terminators and braces.
scopes.preconditions: Initialized configuration context, argument array, log, pool and an in-memory buffer whose logical end is bounded by last.

scopes.contract: Parses command-line configuration parameters and dispatches complete directives to a handler while rejecting blocks and malformed syntax.
scopes.preconditions: The cycle contains an in-memory conf_param and the configuration context uses a side-effect-free accept-all handler.
